title: Fitted doctype-classifier temperature
description: Scalar temperature T used to sharpen or soften the 5-class DocumentTypeClassifier softmax. Produced by Phase 3b fit_temperature.py via NLL minimisation on a 30% held-out G8 split. Consumed by DocumentTypeClassifier.swift.

status.description: Phase 3b output is 'calibrated'. 'placeholder' is reserved for bring-up fixtures that bypass the real fit.

temperature.description: T such that calibrated_softmax(x) = softmax(x / T). T > 1 softens (reduces confidence); T < 1 sharpens.

split_size.description: Number of documents in the held-out calibration split the fit was performed on.

nll_before.description: Mean negative log-likelihood on the held-out split at T=1.

nll_after.description: Mean NLL at the fitted T. Must be <= nll_before.

optimizer.description: Identifier of the 1D minimiser. Pure-Python stdlib (no scipy dep).

iterations.description: Optimiser iterations actually run (bounded by a hard cap).

search_lower.description: Lower end of the 1D search interval.

search_upper.description: Upper end of the 1D search interval.

input_dump_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the Swift softmax dump this fit was run against.

corpus_seed.description: Seed of the G8 corpus the dump was produced from. Recorded for provenance.
